Intelligent Defense

AI That Thinks Like a Fraud Investigator

Financial fraud has evolved from simple chargebacks to sophisticated multi-layered attacks. Our AI doesn't just look for known patterns — it understands behavior, detects anomalies, and adapts in real-time to emerging threats.

We process hundreds of behavioral signals per transaction — from typing patterns and device fingerprints to purchase history and location velocity. The result: a holistic risk profile that catches fraudsters while keeping genuine customers flowing smoothly.

Detection Pipeline

How We Stop Fraud in Its Tracks

A multi-layered approach that combines behavioral analytics, pattern recognition, and adaptive machine learning for comprehensive protection.

Data Ingestion

Connect to transaction streams, user profiles, device data, and external threat intelligence feeds.

Behavioral Profiling

Build unique behavioral fingerprints for each user — typing speed, mouse patterns, navigation flow.

Pattern Recognition

Analyze transaction sequences, velocity, location changes, and network relationships.

Risk Scoring

Score each transaction on a 0-1000 scale with granular risk factors and explanations.

Threat Response

Automated actions: block, challenge, flag for review, or allow with enhanced monitoring.

Continuous Learning

Models retrain daily with new fraud patterns, improving accuracy over time.

Core Capabilities

Enterprise-Grade Fraud Prevention

Multi-Dimensional Scoring

Risk scores factor in amount, velocity, location, device, behavior, and network relationships.

Device Fingerprinting

Track unique device signatures across sessions to identify suspicious access patterns.

Network Analysis

Real-Time Velocity Checks

Flag abnormal transaction frequency, location changes, and timing patterns.

Explainable AI Decisions

Every alert includes clear reasoning — no black boxes, supporting investigation.

Adaptive ML Models

Models that continuously learn from new fraud patterns and evolving attack vectors.

Smart Alerting

Prioritized alerts with risk context, recommended actions, and automated responses.

Compliance Automation

Built-in AML, KYC, and PCI-DSS reporting with comprehensive audit trails.
